title: Bad Bunny Sells Out First Milan Show at Ippodromo SNAI La Maura
detail: Bad Bunny plays a sold-out first Milan date at Ippodromo SNAI La Maura before roughly 80,000 fans (July 17, 2026), the tour's Italian debut. A second Milan show the following night would be cancelled mid-set after a severe hailstorm forced an evacuation of the venue.
